entries.3a63e03cf30f5973: It is a university entrance course, 'University Entrance STEP', for current high school students in grades 1 to 3, providing instruction in Japanese, mathematics, English, science and social studies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,326 million.
entries.40aca34ac2a73a10: This is a single segment, the cram school business, which operates schools in Kanagawa Prefecture. It provides instruction through its Elementary and Junior High School Division and High School Division, and also operates a division for after-school care and childcare and a division responsible for producing and printing teaching materials. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥15,846 million, and the number of students was 36,744 as of the end of September 2025.
entries.456ce21ce8720a92: Teaching Materials Production and Printing Division
entries.55ed41f26bd84942: The Teaching Materials Research Section produces the manuscripts and masters of teaching materials, and the Print and Distribution Center handles various printing and bookbinding, centered on teaching materials, as well as the delivery of items used in lessons. Teaching material income is included in the revenue of the cram school divisions, and no separate amount is disclosed.

entries.8618570b0bc09add: As the after-school class “STEP Kids” for first- to fourth-grade elementary school students, it runs various programs, including study-related programs, exercise and shogi. It also operates “STEP Junior Lab,” a school that offers various programs as independent courses. The nursery division is a company-sponsored childcare facility, “Step Hoikuen,” which admits the children of employees as well as local families within a set quota. The number of employees and revenue of this division are included in the elementary and junior high school division, and no separate amounts are disclosed.
entries.8f0225e564c706fc: A company that operates the "Step" cram schools in Kanagawa Prefecture, providing academic instruction to elementary, junior high and high school students as well as after-school childcare.

entries.fbfcd5150eaee2b3: It is a high school entrance course for students from fifth grade of elementary school to third grade of junior high school, providing instruction in Japanese, mathematics (arithmetic), English, science and social studies. It also offers Hi-STEP courses aimed at highly selective schools. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥12,520 million.
